items.headline: Youri Tielemans signs for Manchester United from Aston Villa
items.summary: Belgium midfielder Youri Tielemans completed a £35 million move from Aston Villa after United activated his release clause. Five-year contract signed.

items.headline: Andrey Santos completes £50m switch from Chelsea to Manchester United
items.summary: Brazilian central midfielder Andrey Santos joined from Chelsea for approximately £50 million. Made pre-season debut against Wrexham.

items.headline: Manchester United targeting Carlos Baleba from Brighton
items.summary: Manchester United reported to be closing in on a deal for Brighton and Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba in midfield reinforcement move.
